mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS templateId, r.id AS templateRevisionId, r.revision_no AS templateVersion, r.rule_version AS ruleVersion, r.frozen_threshold AS threshold, r.priority AS priority FROM acc_satisfaction_questionnaire_template t JOIN acc_satisfaction_questionnaire_template_revision r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.template_id = t.id AND r.id = t.current_revision_id AND r.deleted = b'0' WHERE t.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.deleted = b'0' AND r.revision_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.project_type = #{query.projectType} AND r.signing_mode = #{query.signingMode} AND r.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode} AND r.business_purpose_code = #{query.businessPurposeCode} AND r.applicable_timing_code = #{query.applicableTimingCode} ORDER BY r.priority DESC, r.id
